information_updates.finding: The electric-field scroll-wave experiment is a high-value nonlinear-control benchmark because a constant applied field can induce drift and alter the dynamics of partially pinned three-dimensional excitation structures.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 35293 is the article start page, not the applied field strength.

information_updates.finding: The high-pressure prion study combines FTIR structural readout with pressure perturbation calorimetry and reversible/irreversible state changes, providing a useful multiphysics stress-response validation pattern.

The SPring-8 result indexed by 32359 provides an atomic-scale catalytic-structure characterization reference for fcc ruthenium nanoparticles and should be retained in the materials evidence corpus independently of the identifier collision.
